epics.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Cycle Findings
epics.jtbd: When a self-falsification audit identifies unresolved findings, I want the root causes to be fixed directly, so that the container starts and the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope.
requirements: R1: Reject PRs introducing orchestrator concepts as client domain product code.
R2: Remove manual SecurityContextHolder injection in AuthController and fix the JWT filter.
R3: Trace and fix the causal mechanism producing 401s in JwtAuthenticationFilter.
R4: Implement missing role synchronization for Epidemiologists and access control based on Moodle courses.

slices.title: Fix JWT filter authentication and Moodle role synchronization
slices.jtbd: When implementing the resolution of self-falsification findings for this epic, I want to fix the root causes in the authentication flow, so that the self-falsification audit passes and the API functions correctly
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PR that inappropriately implements factory orchestrator concepts, When a review verdict is issued, Then the verdict must be REJECT.
Given a stateless JWT API, When authenticating via Moodle, Then the JWT filter correctly processes the token without manual context injection.
Given the Moodle integration, When an Epidemiologist authenticates, Then their roles and course-based access are correctly synchronized and enforced.
Given the required single implementation slice, When tests are run, Then they provide sufficient unit, integration, and E2E coverage for the modified authentication and authorization logic.
